label: Agent
summary: One agent turn against the feature worktree: writes the declared artifacts, optionally checked by a verifier.

config_schema.description: Configuration for an `agent` node: one agent turn against the feature worktree, producing declared artifacts and optionally verified by a harness/verifier turn.

agent_kind.description: Per-step agent runtime override (e.g. `claude-code`). Unset inherits the run/project chain.

allow_network.description: Opt this step into web search / fetch.

allow_shell.description: Opt a non-shell capability into the shell.

artifacts.description: Declared artifact captures (name/path/capture strategy) committed or stored after the turn.

capability.description: Write-scope capability class (ReadOnly / Artifacts / Implement). Unset infers the safe default.

max_iterations.description: v1 legacy retry budget. In v2 the retry block owns budgets; migration lifts this when an on_failure existed, and keeps it here only as inert author intent.

model.description: Per-step model override. Resolves below the run-time per-step override, above the project default.

prompt_template.description: The step's prompt template. Supports the `{{...}}` placeholders documented in PROMPT_CONTEXT.

rework_prompt_template.description: Prompt rendered instead of `prompt_template` when a verdict from behind this step's task-list consumer sends the run back here — the previous cycle's code is already on the branch, so the step emits a delta rather than a whole decomposition. Unset falls back to `prompt_template`.

verifier.description: Optional harness/verifier turn run after the agent turn; a FAIL verdict feeds the retry policy.

label: Gate
summary: Pause for a human decision: approve, reject, or send the run back to an earlier node with feedback.

config_schema.description: Configuration for a `gate` node: park the run for a human decision (approve / reject / redirect). The gate inherits its predecessor's artifacts for review.

gate_class.description: Blast-radius class. `dangerous` (merge to default, push to protected, deploy, delete) is parked for a human even on unattended runs; unset or `safe` auto-approves unattended.

label: Sequence
summary: Fan a task list into one agent turn per task, checkpointing each task as it lands.

config_schema.description: Configuration for a `sequence` node: run an ordered task list, one fresh agent session per task, in a single worktree, merging once at the end. The task list arrives on a typed `task_list` edge (v1: `task_list_from`); without one, the node plans its own decomposition.

agent_kind.description: Per-step agent runtime override for the task agents. Unset inherits the run/project chain.

allow_network.description: Opt the task agents into web search / fetch.

allow_shell.description: Opt a non-shell capability into the shell.

artifacts.description: Declared artifact captures committed or stored after the step.

capability.description: Write-scope capability class. Sequence steps default to Implement (they legitimately write across the source tree).

max_iterations.description: v1 legacy retry budget; see the agent node's field of the same name.

model.description: Per-step model override for the task agents.

prompt_template.description: Prompt template each task agent renders, with the task's own goal injected.

verifier.description: Optional harness/verifier turn run after the list lands; a FAIL verdict feeds the retry policy targeted at the tasks owning the implicated files.

label: Sync
summary: Merge the default branch into the feature branch, resolving any conflict with an agent turn.

config_schema.description: Configuration for a `sync` node: fetch + merge origin/<default_branch> into the feature branch; on conflict, spawn a resolution agent and route the outcome through the node's retry policy (v1: on_failure).

agent_kind.description: Agent runtime override for the conflict-resolution turn. Unset inherits the run/project chain.

effort.description: Reasoning-effort override for the resolution turn. Unset inherits.

model.description: Model override for the resolution turn.

label: Finalize
summary: Squash the feature branch and publish it. Ends the run — nothing may follow.

config_schema.description: Configuration for a `finalize` node: merge the feature branch outcome, author the run summary / PR description with a bounded agent turn, and clean up.

agent_kind.description: Agent runtime override for the summary turn. Unset inherits the run/project chain.

effort.description: Reasoning-effort override for the summary turn. Unset inherits.

model.description: Model override for the summary turn.

prompt_template.description: Prompt template for the summary turn.

label: Command
summary: Run a deterministic shell command (harness, build, script) at zero token cost.

config_schema.description: Configuration for a `command` node: run a deterministic shell command in a disposable worktree off the feature branch, at zero token cost. Its stdout is captured as an artifact and a non-zero exit fails the step as a verdict. The worktree is NOT merged back — a command that must change tracked files needs an agent step.

artifacts.description: Declared deliverables. Only `last_write_to` captures apply: each path is read back off the worktree after the command exits, and a missing one fails the step.

capability.description: Write-scope classification. Only used by the parallel-scheduling lint (PRD §5.6) — a command node enforces no fence of its own.

command.description: Shell command to run, verbatim, under an interactive login shell (so the user's PATH and any mise/asdf/nvm shims are active). Required unless `measure_baseline` is set.

cwd.description: Worktree-relative working directory. Unset runs at the worktree root; absolute paths and `..` segments are refused.

env_allowlist.description: Names of environment variables forwarded from Demeteo's process into the command. Nothing crosses unless named here; unset names are skipped.

idempotent.description: True when re-running this command after a crash is safe (a build, a test run). Leave false for anything with outside side effects (deploy, publish, migration): an interrupted attempt then always parks at the synthetic gate instead of re-running.

measure_baseline.description: Measure the harness baseline instead of running `command`: the node runs this PROJECT's prepare command plus every harness that gates validation, and records what each said at the commit it measured. Only valid at the head of the graph, where the feature branch still points at the base commit. A red gate is recorded, not judged — subtracting it from validate's verdict is a separate decision.

timeout_secs.description: Wall-clock ceiling. Expiry is classified as an environment failure. Unset means no ceiling.
